name: Describe the case
description: Pick a prepared compliance scenario or describe your own: a fact pattern plus structured facts (who, what, where, when). Produces the case every later step works on.

config.label: Form
config.help: Prepared scenarios come from the service's data/scenarios folder. An own case is typed in by whoever uses the platform.

config.label: Structured fact fields
config.default: who, what, where_collected, when_collected, commercial_pathway, dsi, pressure
config.help: Comma-separated. These are the chips shown under the fact pattern, matching brief.json's facts keys.
